title: HarnessCapabilityProfile
description: The provider-neutral adapter capability profile contract (SW1311-HARNESS-001). A profile is DATA, never code: it declares which of the eight dispatch capabilities an adapter supports, which authority a role holds, whether native delegation / direct-shell bypass is permitted, and the separated run-statuses (documented, installed, dispatch-proven, production) as four independent facts. The concrete harness name belongs in the adapter's own file key, never in core dispatch.

adapter.description: The concrete harness name. This is the only place a literal harness name is allowed; core dispatch reads the name as opaque data.

capabilities.description: Which of the eight dispatch capabilities this adapter supports. A missing capability falls closed to false.

authority.description: The capability/authority this role holds, distinct from every other role. One role, one authority: controller, ops, reviewer, observer and integrator are never conflated.

delegation.description: How this adapter may hand work out. skillweave_dispatch is the allowed general path; native_delegation and direct_shell are bypasses that must fail closed when strict mode requires SkillWeave dispatch.

statuses.description: Four independently evidenced run-status facts about this adapter. documented, installed, dispatch-proven and production are NOT one axis: a written name is never a proven run, and neither is ever a production profile.

skill-digests.description: The installed skill names and their expected content digests this adapter binds to in strict mode. A missing or stale digest must be refused before a worker launch.

evidence.description: Actual per-harness real-run evidence (a resolved model, exit code, artifact), never a stable transport-parity claim.
